fields.name: Reported actor name
fields.definition: Source-reported threat actor name; no account ownership inferred.

fields.name: Company name
fields.definition: Company reported by the source; not automatically a merchant.

fields.name: Date of birth
fields.definition: Accepted calendar dates; no automatic association with a particular name.

fields.name: Alias name
fields.definition: Source-reported alias or moniker. Link to a person only when supported.

fields.name: Age
fields.definition: Source-reported age, including units. Do not derive without a defined reference date.

fields.name: Place of birth
fields.definition: Source-reported birthplace, distinct from address and residence.

fields.name: Occupation
fields.definition: Source-reported occupation or job title.

fields.name: Employer name
fields.definition: Organization explicitly reported as an employer.

fields.name: COC source label
fields.definition: Preserve the COC label and value. The abbreviation meaning has not been confirmed.

fields.name: COR source label
fields.definition: Preserve the COR label and value. The abbreviation meaning has not been confirmed.

fields.name: Registered agent
fields.definition: Person or organization explicitly identified as a registered agent.

fields.name: Alternate trade name
fields.definition: Source-reported alternate business or trading name.

fields.name: Reported gender
fields.definition: Gender explicitly reported in the source. Do not infer from a name.

fields.name: Address
fields.definition: Source-reported addresses; ownership and address components not inferred.

fields.name: Phone number
fields.definition: Normalized phone strings; mobile status and country code not inferred.

fields.name: Email address
fields.definition: Email strings passing the configured basic format check.

fields.name: Previous address
fields.definition: Address explicitly described as previous or former. Preserve any supplied date context.

fields.name: Beneficiary address
fields.definition: Address explicitly attributed to a beneficiary.

fields.name: Bank name
fields.definition: Source bank names; aliases have not been consolidated.

fields.name: Account number
fields.definition: Account identifiers preserved as text, including leading zeros.

fields.name: Routing number
fields.definition: Nine-digit routing values passing the configured checksum.

fields.name: SWIFT code
fields.definition: Source SWIFT values passing a syntax check.

fields.name: Bank location
fields.definition: Explicit bank location; no bank/location pairing inferred.

fields.name: Beneficiary name
fields.definition: Name explicitly attributed to a beneficiary. Never infer from event co-occurrence.

fields.name: Account holder name
fields.definition: Name explicitly attributed to an account holder. Requires evidence linking the name and account.

fields.name: Remitter name
fields.definition: Name explicitly identified as the remitter or sender.

fields.name: Payee name
fields.definition: Name explicitly identified as the payee or recipient.

fields.name: For benefit of instructions
fields.definition: Reported FBO instruction. Preserve the full instruction and its relationship evidence.

fields.name: For further credit instructions
fields.definition: Reported FFC instruction. Preserve the full instruction and its relationship evidence.

fields.name: Account type
fields.definition: Explicit account type, such as the source-labeled receiving account type.

fields.name: Amount
fields.definition: Accepted reported amounts. Explicit currency symbols retained; currency code unknown.

fields.name: Shares
fields.definition: Reported share quantities; no transaction or stock pairing inferred.

fields.name: Stock symbol
fields.definition: Reported stock symbols; exchange not inferred.

fields.name: Net amount
fields.definition: Explicit net amount, distinct from gross amount and generic reported amount.

fields.name: Gross amount
fields.definition: Explicit gross amount. Empty source labels do not supply an amount.

fields.name: Federal tax withholding
fields.definition: Reported federal tax or withholding amount. Preserve the original tax label.

fields.name: State tax withholding
fields.definition: Reported state tax or withholding amount. Preserve the original tax label.

fields.name: Principal amount
fields.definition: Explicit principal amount, separate from fees, taxes and totals.

fields.name: Total amount
fields.definition: Source-reported total. Preserve what was totaled and its scope.

fields.name: Reported currency
fields.definition: Explicit currency code. Do not infer currency from an ambiguous symbol.

fields.name: Loss status
fields.definition: Source wording about loss, including explicit no-loss statements. Not a monetary amount.

fields.name: Recovery status
fields.definition: Source wording about recovery or return of funds. Not a recovered amount.

fields.name: Full SSN
fields.definition: Full-format source SSN values passing structural checks; identity unverified.

fields.name: Partial SSN
fields.definition: Reserved final field. Current short SSN values require review and are not populated here.

fields.name: EIN / FEIN
fields.definition: Source-labeled EIN/FEIN identifier. Do not treat it as an SSN.

fields.name: TIN
fields.definition: Source-labeled TIN identifier. Do not assume it is an SSN or EIN.

fields.name: Driver's license number
fields.definition: Source-labeled license identifier. Preserve letters, masks and leading zeros.

fields.name: Driver's license state
fields.definition: Explicit license-issuing state. Link to a license only when supported.

fields.name: Passport number
fields.definition: Source-labeled passport identifier. Nationality and ownership are separate facts.

fields.name: Document issue date
fields.definition: Explicit issue date. Its document relationship must be supported.

fields.name: Card PAN
fields.definition: Explicit card values passing configured length/checksum rules; never inferred from arbitrary numbers.

fields.name: Card BIN
fields.definition: Explicit six/eight-digit BIN; not derived from account numbers.

fields.name: Merchant name
fields.definition: Requires explicit merchant evidence. Company alone is insufficient.

fields.name: Merchant category code (MCC)
fields.definition: Explicit merchant category code (MCC), stored as a text identifier.

fields.name: Source IP
fields.definition: Source IP values passing syntax validation.

fields.name: Destination IP
fields.definition: Destination IP values passing syntax validation.

fields.name: Domain
fields.definition: Domain strings passing the configured syntax check.

fields.name: URL
fields.definition: HTTP/HTTPS URL strings passing the configured syntax check.

fields.name: Device fingerprint
fields.definition: Source-reported device identifiers.

fields.name: User agent
fields.definition: Source-reported user-agent strings.

fields.name: Domain creation date
fields.definition: Source-reported domain creation date. Link to the domain only when explicit.

fields.name: Domain registrar
fields.definition: Registrar explicitly associated with a domain.

fields.name: Registrant region
fields.definition: Source-reported registrant state/province.

fields.name: Reported crime datetime
fields.definition: Source crime datetimes; timezone is preserved only when supplied.

fields.name: Reporter
fields.definition: Source Reported By values; not assumed to be the actor or victim.

fields.name: Incident type
fields.definition: Source-reported incident classification. Retain the original label and supporting narrative.

fields.name: Fraud channel
fields.definition: Reported channel through which activity occurred, such as web, phone or ATM.

fields.name: Geographic area
fields.definition: Source-reported geographic scope of activity. It is not a person address.

fields.name: Reported tactics
fields.definition: Source description of tactics or TTPs. Preserve original wording.

fields.name: Fraud indicators
fields.definition: Source-reported fraud indicators as narrative evidence.

fields.name: Complaint reference
fields.definition: Source complaint reference, separate from MISP and CyFin event identifiers.

fields.name: Transaction type
fields.definition: Source description of a transfer, payment or other transaction type.

fields.name: Transaction status
fields.definition: Reported status such as sent, blocked or executed. Interpret the status in its transaction context.

fields.name: Transaction memo
fields.definition: Memo associated with a reported transaction.

fields.name: Transaction reference
fields.definition: Trace or payment-system reference. Preserve its source reference type.

fields.name: Check number
fields.definition: Check identifier, stored as text including masks and leading zeros.

fields.name: Process date
fields.definition: Source processing date. Keep separate from event date and crime datetime.

fields.name: Buy / sell action
fields.definition: Reported buy/sell action or side. Generic Action labels need trade context.

fields.name: Order number
fields.definition: Order identifier stored as text. A single event can contain multiple orders.

fields.name: CUSIP
fields.definition: Source-labeled CUSIP security identifier, distinct from the stock symbol.

fields.name: Security name
fields.definition: Reported security or fund name.

fields.name: Price per share
fields.definition: Explicit per-share price. Preserve currency and the associated trade evidence.

fields.name: Reported price
fields.definition: Price with an unspecified unit. Do not assume it means price per share.

fields.name: Execution time
fields.definition: Reported execution time and supplied timezone. Do not invent a missing date or timezone.

fields.name: Reported time
fields.definition: Source Time label whose event or transaction meaning needs context.

fields.name: Gain / loss
fields.definition: Reported gain/loss value. Preserve sign, currency and transaction evidence.

fields.name: Broker number
fields.definition: Source-labeled broker identifier. Its issuing system must be retained or reviewed.

fields.name: DTC number
fields.definition: Source-labeled DTC number stored as an identifier.

fields.name: Counterparty firm
fields.definition: Reported counterparty firm. Association with an account requires explicit evidence.

fields.name: Counterparty account number
fields.definition: Account explicitly attributed to the counterparty firm.

fields.name: CRD number
fields.definition: Source-labeled CRD identifier, distinct from a generic broker number.

fields.name: Username
fields.definition: Source-reported username or login identifier. Preserve platform when stated.

fields.name: Telegram handle
fields.definition: Telegram handle explicitly named in the source.

fields.name: Instagram handle
fields.definition: Instagram handle explicitly named in the source.

fields.name: WhatsApp ID
fields.definition: WhatsApp identifier explicitly named in the source.

fields.name: Payment token
fields.definition: Source-reported payment token. Its email/phone form does not by itself establish ownership.

fields.name: Skimmer type
fields.definition: Source description of the skimmer type, such as POS.

fields.name: Device brand / model
fields.definition: Brand/model reported in the skimming-device context.

fields.name: Device count
fields.definition: Source-reported count in device context. Preserve the item counted.

fields.name: Store number
fields.definition: Explicit store identifier, separate from the store or merchant name.

fields.name: License plate number
fields.definition: Source-reported vehicle plate identifier, including partial or masked forms.

fields.name: License plate state
fields.definition: State explicitly associated with a license plate.

fields.name: Vehicle VIN
fields.definition: Explicit vehicle VIN. Preserve its vehicle relationship and validation status.

fields.name: Contract date
fields.definition: Source contract date. Preserve the contract or property association.

fields.name: Closing date
fields.definition: Source closing date. Preserve the transaction or property association.

fields.name: File md5
fields.definition: Explicit MISP source type/label value. Preserve provenance, format validation and permissions; no ownership/attribution inference.

fields.name: File sha1
fields.definition: Explicit MISP source type/label value. Preserve provenance, format validation and permissions; no ownership/attribution inference.

fields.name: File sha256
fields.definition: Explicit MISP source type/label value. Preserve provenance, format validation and permissions; no ownership/attribution inference.

fields.name: File imphash
fields.definition: Explicit MISP source type/label value. Preserve provenance, format validation and permissions; no ownership/attribution inference.

fields.name: File ssdeep
fields.definition: Explicit MISP source type/label value. Preserve provenance, format validation and permissions; no ownership/attribution inference.

fields.name: File name
fields.definition: Explicit MISP source type/label value. Preserve provenance, format validation and permissions; no ownership/attribution inference.

fields.name: File size bytes
fields.definition: Explicit MISP source type/label value. Preserve provenance, format validation and permissions; no ownership/attribution inference.

fields.name: Target organization
fields.definition: Explicit MISP source type/label value. Preserve provenance, format validation and permissions; no ownership/attribution inference.

fields.name: Observation first seen
fields.definition: Explicit MISP source type/label value. Preserve provenance, format validation and permissions; no ownership/attribution inference.

fields.name: Observation last seen
fields.definition: Explicit MISP source type/label value. Preserve provenance, format validation and permissions; no ownership/attribution inference.

fields.name: Reported datetime
fields.definition: Explicit MISP source type/label value. Preserve provenance, format validation and permissions; no ownership/attribution inference.

fields.name: Skimmer venue / location name
fields.definition: Name from Store label in an explicit skimming-device record. Not assumed to be a transaction merchant.

fields.name: Reported IP address
fields.definition: Explicit IP address label without source/destination direction. Do not infer traffic direction.
